assertions.text: Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column — this was missing in the @ParameterizedTest and should be added.
assertions.evidence: Scenario | Email | Valid? (Scenario is leftmost column)

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?' (e.g. 'Valid?' or 'Expected?')
Test method body contains no if or switch statements
Scenario names describe conditions ('Valid standard format', 'Missing local part') — not outcomes ('True', 'False') or 'Test case 1'.
assertions.evidence: Standard address, Missing local part, Empty string, No @ symbol

assertions.text: Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName (if present), @Description (if present), @TableTest — not any other order.
assertions.evidence: @TableTest only annotation; correct position before method

assertions.text: Test method has either a @DisplayName annotation or a method name that reads as a clear, descriptive title when converted from camelCase/snake_case.
assertions.evidence: Method name: shouldValidateEmail (reads: should validate email)

assertions.text: If @Description is present and the text is longer than a single short line, it uses a text block (triple-quoted string """), not string concatenation with +. Passes if @Description is absent.
